text:
marta: Heads-up from the SDK rollout: several examples still use `max_tokens` and the old `function_call` object. CI smoke tests flagged failures for Dedicated customers.

leo: can you paste the top paths? i'll take JS/TS snippets + the migration guide.

marta: found `docs/snippets/js/quickstart.md`, `docs/guides/migrations/v1-to-v2.md` code blocks, and `docs/integrations/vector-stores/postgres.md` (embed dim note). Also some snapshot tests in `internal/test-fixtures/` referencing key `function_call`.

anya: i'll handle Python and the test fixtures. note: snapshots will fail if we blindly rename keys; recommend a small jq-based transform for JSON fixtures.

frank: i'll do a lightweight codemod for JS (`jscodeshift`) and add guidance in the PR description for maintainers. plan to include an example sed/jq combo: 

```
# find files and replace simple cases
git grep -l "max_tokens" docs | xargs sed -i 's/max_tokens/max_output_tokens/g'

# transform JSON fixtures safely (jq):
jq 'walk(if type=="object" and has("function_call") then .tool_calls=[{tool:.function_call.name,args:(.function_call.arguments|fromjson? // {})}] | del(.function_call) else . end)' input.json > output.json
```

leo: add a big warning in the vector-store pages about embedding dims: rwd-2 was 1536, rwd-3-compat is 2048. If customers don't reindex they'll see shape mismatch errors. Include a one-line reindex recipe and a sample script.

anya: on snapshots: propose adding a small test shim that normalizes both shapes so CI doesn't break while docs transition. Example pseudo: in tests, accept `tool_calls` or `function_call` and normalize to `tool_calls[0]`. We'll include that as a short code snippet in the migration guide.

marta: draft deprecation copy for the banner: "Legacy `max_tokens` and `function_call` will be removed on 2026-06-30. Please migrate by 2026-06-10." We'll confirm with PM/legal before publishing.

frank: opened PRs: 8120 (js codemod + snippets) and 8121 (migration guide updates). PR descriptions include codemod link, sed/jq recipes, and a note about streaming differences for tool payloads.

ci-bot: PRs 8120 & 8121: lint OK, snippet smoke tests queued. Noted: snapshot check failed for one internal test referencing `function_call` in `tests/fixtures/user_flow.json`.

anya: pushed a small fixture transform and test shim in a follow-up commit to PR 8121 to avoid snapshot flakiness; included instructions for maintainers how to rebaseline snapshots after migration.

leo: merged JS snippets PR 8120 after adding before/after examples. Will add a short codemod link in the migration guide so other maintainers can run transforms locally.

marta: once merged we'll stage the banner and run an expedited docs build. @docs-bot can you post the build URL when ready?

docs-bot: staged banner and rebuild queued https://deploys.redwood-inference.com/builds/8750. Smoke tests running (~20m).

frank: small follow-up: remind integrators that tests and snapshot fixtures are a common gotcha. include a troubleshooting bullet in the migration doc: how to update Jest snapshots, pytest fixtures, and how to run the jq transform in CI.

anya: also added a short FAQ entry: "My index returns shape error after switching to rwd-3-compat" with steps to verify vector_dim and a link to the reindex sample script.

marta: thanks team. post-merge checklist: 1) trigger site rebuild, 2) publish banner after PM signoff, 3) notify support + cs with reindex recipe, 4) tag infra for a short maintenance window for Dedicated customers.

(THREAD END)
